<p class="chapter-subtitle">Reading code and expressing rules, state, and change</p>

The Julia Programming module develops the language skills needed to understand a small simulation. It begins with reading Julia values, expressions, collections, and notation. It then uses functions, decisions, repetition, randomness, and mutation to express how a simple population changes over time.
